title: Animated Hover Card
subtitle: A preview that appears when you hover a link.
patches: "flex min-h-[40vh] items-center justify-center rounded-lg border px-6 text-sm"
<Button type="button" variant="outline" size="lg" onClick={shuffle} className="h-11.5 rounded-md px-4">

const linkClass = values.underline
    ? "font-medium text-(--hx-primary)"
    : "font-medium text-(--hx-primary) underline underline-offset-4"
"flex min-h-80 items-center justify-center px-6 text-sm max-md:min-h-64 max-md:px-0"

descriptions.site: Website the card previews. Needs Card shows set to Website preview.
descriptions.source: What the card shows: a preview of the website or manually written details.
descriptions.contentAnimation: How the card appears: scales and fades, or only fades.
descriptions.startScale: Size the card starts from when it opens, as a fraction of full size.
descriptions.fadeContent: Fades the card contents in as it opens.
descriptions.openDelay: How long you hover before the card opens, in seconds.
descriptions.closeDelay: How long after leaving before the card closes, in seconds.
descriptions.followCursor: The card follows the pointer instead of staying put.
descriptions.underline: The link underline draws in on hover.

themeDescription: Colour palette, card included. Its primary colour fills the card's button.
